summary: Frontend-only smoke + visual rendering test on Razorpay Capital Auto Dealer NACH onboarding prototype at 1440x900. All 33 data-testid elements render and are visible. All required textual content (hero, features, journey steps 1-5, NACH mandate form, FAQ, repayment cycle, documents, CTA footer) is present. FAQ accordion default-open + toggle behavior works. Anchor nav clicks scroll to journey & faq sections. Zero console errors on load. NACH form Step 3 centerpiece renders with all 4 colored callouts (green/blue/orange/red) and required fields (UMRN, RZRPY00001, CREATE checked, RAZORPAY CAPITAL PRIVATE LIMITED, IFSC HDFC0001234, WEEKLY highlighted red, signature boxes, stamp box).

issues: Right-side callouts 'Weekly — aligned to your sales cycle' and 'Company stamp required' use translate-x-[105%] which pushes them partially off the right viewport edge at 1440px wide; text gets clipped (e.g. 'Weekly — alig...'). Consider moving callouts inside the form or reducing translate offset, or constrain the parent container max-width with extra right padding so callouts remain visible. Left-side callouts render fine.

action_items: Optional: fix right-side NACH callouts being clipped on 1440-wide viewports (visual polish, not functional).
critical_code_review_comments: All components clean, well-structured, files <500 lines.
All interactive elements have data-testid - good testability.
No backend usage as expected; all CTAs are #-anchors.
Right callouts on NachForm.jsx use translate-x-[105%] which overflows at typical desktop widths - visual clipping at viewport edge.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pure static frontend prototype, no backend. All testids verified at 1440x900. Only minor visual polish item: right NACH callouts clip at viewport edge.
